name: Lawrence Hall of Science Youth Volunteers
org: Lawrence Hall of Science, UC Berkeley
what_you_do: You staff exhibits such as the planetarium. Others are Ingenuity Challenges, Outdoor Nature Lab and Animal Discovery Zone. The minimum is 21 summer hours. During the school year, it is 2 shifts a month.
who_can_apply: Page lists 2024 cycle rules: entering 9th grade or older and age 14 by June 1, 2024. Not a current volunteer. Own transportation to Berkeley. No current rules posted.
duration: Summer minimum 21 hours; school year two 3-hour shifts a month
deadline_text: Paused. The page says there will be no Summer 2025 cohort and a re-imagined youth volunteer program is planned for 2026, with no dates posted. Last posted window closed Jan 16, 2024.
how_to_apply: Check the Lawrence Hall of Science teen volunteer page; contact veronicau@berkeley.edu or 510-642-5132.
notes: The page says recruiting is paused and a re-imagined program is planned for 2026, with no dates. Its Apply Today teen link conflicts with the pause notice, so do not treat it as active. Call or email to ask whether the program has launched. The age rules come from 2024 wording, so the age fields are blank.
